title: Look Before You Leap: Pre-Action Verification for LLM Agents
content:
arXiv:2609.11957v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An LLM agent acts on the world by emitting actions: shell commands to run, edits to apply. A wrong action does not always fail loudly; it can fail silently, producing a plausible but incorrect effect that raises no error. We argue that a cheap deterministic check, run before an action takes effect, is an effective and underused form of agent oversight, and we study it across two action modalities in one framework. The idea is to fix an action's correct effect by construction, before any executor runs, so that silent failure is measured directly and the verifier may abstain rather than guess. For shell commands, a static verifier over 9930 commands and 482 tools catches 95.8% of invalid commands at a 10.0% false-positive rate. Its syntax and binary checks are oracle-exact, giving zero false positives while catching half of all errors; the flag check is bounded only by help-text coverage and accounts for every false positive. For code edit
author: Asaad Althoubi
summary_zh: 论文提出为 LLM Agent 增加「行动前验证」机制：在 shell 命令执行或代码编辑真正生效前，用廉价的确定性静态检查拦截错误动作，重点针对不报错却产生错误结果的「静默失败」。在 9930 条命令、482 个工具上，静态验证器以 10% 误报率拦截了 95.8% 的无效命令，且验证器可选择「弃权」而非瞎猜。

title: Async GRPO with LoRA across HF Jobs: a bucket, a proxy, and no NCCL
summary_zh: 文章介绍了在 HuggingFace Jobs 上运行异步 GRPO 强化学习训练的工程实践，通过对象存储桶传递权重、代理转发推理请求，彻底绕开了 NCCL 分布式通信的复杂性。结合 LoRA 降低显存与权重同步成本，为在无高速互联的异构云环境中做 RL 后训练提供了可复用的低门槛架构范式。

title: Harness or Model? Isolating the Harness Effect in Agentic Coding with a Contamination-Controlled Private Suite
content:
arXiv:2609.11987v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An agentic coding system couples a language model to a harness: the tools, prompts and control flow that turn a chat model into an autonomous software engineer. Vendors ship harnesses tuned to their own models, and practitioners assume the vendor-native pairing solves more tasks. We measure that assumption with paired same-model contrasts on a private, contamination-controlled suite of 256 repository and post-cutoff contest tasks. The same 80 tasks ran under claude-agent-sdk and under deepagents on claude-opus-4-8, and under the openai-codex SDK and deepagents on gpt-5.5, with gemini-3.5-flash and deepseek-v3.2 as side cells. 792 of 800 planned runs were graded by an isolated oracle. Neither contrast resolves an average advantage for either harness: -1.25 pp for Opus 4.8 (48.8% vs 50.0%, task-bootstrap 95% CI [-10.0, +7.5]) and +1.25 pp for GPT-5.5 (55.6% vs 54.4%, CI [-4.4, +6.9]). The Opus average combines opposite strata: the native h
author: Mohsen Arjmandi
summary_zh: 这篇论文用一套私有、防污染的 256 项任务基准，通过「同模型不同 harness」的配对对照实验，分离了智能体编程系统中「脚手架（工具、提示、控制流）」与「模型本身」各自的贡献。结果显示 claude-agent-sdk 与第三方 deepagents 在同一模型上并未分出平均优劣，挑战了「厂商自家 harness 配自家模型最优」的普遍假设。对选型 Agent SDK 和评估编程智能体的实践者有直接参考价值。

title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
content:
arXiv:2609.11977v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Co-work agents execute complex workflows that combine information gathering, tool use, coding, and file manipulation across many model invocations. Because cost and latency accumulate over the full episode, their practical value depends not only on peak capability but also on how efficiently that capability is delivered. Yet many steps in everyday work emphasize state tracking, coordination, recovery, and follow-through rather than frontier-scale reasoning. We present Occamy-1.0, a cost-efficient co-work model obtained by further training the post-trained Qwen3.6-35B-A3B checkpoint. We construct execution-grounded data and environments, capture replayable long-horizon trajectories across multiple harnesses, and use staged post-training to develop and consolidate complementary execution capabilities. Across a broad suite of co-work benchmarks, Occamy-1.0 is consistently among the strongest comparably sized models and remains competitive w
author: Wenhui Chen, Shiwen Cheng, Hao Dong, Chenda Duan, Ruixiang Feng, Zhong Guan, Boqiang Guo, Xueyuan Han, Haojie Hao, Liangmeng Huang, Zhelong Huang, Xinke Kong, Hongyu Li, Jiazheng Li, Junbo Li, Qingchuan Li, Yukun Lian, Chang Liu, Tianyu Liu, Zicheng Liu, Shuyi Ouyang, Yijun Pan, Kunyu Shi, Xiaojun Tang, Bingquan Wang, Kesu Wang, Yuchen Wang, Sibo Wei, Sicong Xie, Xiaoying Xing, Yi Xu, Zhijun Xu, Hongwei Xue, Qingcheng Zeng, Di Zhang, Guannan Zhang, Haochen Zhang, Tianlong Zhang, Tianyu Zhao, Tianyu Zhao, Yanjun Zheng, Jialong Zhu, Zijian Zou
summary_zh: Occamy-1.0 是基于 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 进一步训练的开源协同工作（co-work）模型，专门面向融合信息检索、工具调用、编码与文件操作的长链路 Agent 工作流。论文强调这类日常任务更依赖状态跟踪、协调、错误恢复与任务贯彻能力，而非前沿级推理，因此通过执行落地的数据与环境、可重放的长程轨迹和分阶段后训练，在成本-能力帕累托前沿上取得平衡。对关注本地化/低成本 Coding Agent 替代方案的开发者有参考价值。

title: Cheap LLM code review is fine until it hits an authorization bug
content: A code review vendor ran its own eval comparing a $1.20-per-million-output-token model (Luna) against a frontier one (Astra) across 50 public benchmark pull requests from Cal.com, Sentry, Discourse, Keycloak and Grafana. The numbers are worth reading cold, because they show exactly where the cheap model falls apart. Luna found 69 verified bugs for a total run cost of $0.20. Astra found 92 for $5.66. Per verified bug that is $0.0030 against $0.061, a 20x gap. On everyday data and logic bugs the cheap model kept up: 39 verified against Astra's 47. On concurrency, 10 against 13. Those are the stats that justify routing every PR to the cheap model and calling it a day. Then look at the security split. Luna caught 9 of the 24 security bugs. Astra caught 19. And on Keycloak, the IAM server, Luna found 6 verified bugs to Astra's 14, with only half its findings holding up against 93% for Astra. That is not a gently declining curve. It is a cliff on exactly the code you cannot afford to review
author: Cole Halton
summary_zh: 文章基于 50 个公开 PR（Cal.com、Sentry、Discourse、Keycloak、Grafana）对比了廉价模型与前沿模型在 AI 代码审查中的表现：廉价模型以 0.20 美元找出 69 个已验证缺陷，前沿模型花费 5.66 美元找出 92 个，单缺陷成本相差 20 倍。关键结论是二者在常规逻辑与并发缺陷上差距不大，但在安全类缺陷上差距悬殊（9/24 对 19/24），尤其是权限与认证类问题。对于搭建 AI 代码审查流水线的团队，这提供了按 PR 风险分级路由模型的实用依据。

title: Your Coding Agent Isn't Solving the Bug. It's Finding the Answer Key.
content: Two things happened in the same week this September, and together they say something uncomfortable about how we measure coding agents. First, OpenAI published a note explaining why it no longer evaluates on SWE-bench Verified — the benchmark that has anchored agentic coding claims for two years is saturated and no longer discriminates between frontier systems. Second, a preprint called SWE-Bench Pro Verified landed, and its headline finding is blunt: when you close the leakage channels that let agents cheat, some models score substantially worse than previously reported . Not "slightly noisy." Worse. The numbers on the leaderboard were measuring something other than software engineering capability. If you are picking a model for a coding agent, an internal dev tool, or an automated refactor pipeline, this matters more than another point of MMLU. So let's be precise about what actually goes wrong, because the industry keeps collapsing two very different failure modes into one word — "co
author: SyncSoft.AI
summary_zh: 文章指出 SWE-bench Verified 已饱和失效，OpenAI 已停止将其作为评估基准；新的 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 预印本在堵住数据泄漏渠道后发现，部分模型的真实得分远低于榜单宣称水平。核心提醒是：榜单排名可能衡量的是「找到答案」而非真实软件工程能力，选型编码 Agent 或内部开发工具时不应盲信基准分数。

title: DeepSeek Harness Series (07): Capability Seams — Swap One Config Line, Swap Everything
content:
Start with a Household Analogy Think about a light switch. It doesn't care where the electricity comes from — the power grid, a solar panel, or a generator all work fine. The switch only defines one thing: on/off. As long as whatever is behind it honors that interface, you flip it and the light comes on. That's the essence of a Seam : an interface boundary that separates "using this capability" from "how this capability is implemented." In dsh: Filesystem operations are a Seam ( ctx.fs ) Shell execution is a Seam ( ctx.shell ) LLM calls are a Seam ( ctx.llm ) Process sandboxing is a Seam ( ctx.sandbox ) You can swap the default local filesystem for an E2B sandbox filesystem without changing a single line of tool code. That's the problem Capability Seams solve. Three Roles in Every Seam Every Seam involves three participants: ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Consumer: tool-fs                                     │
│  import ctx.fs → calls ctx.fs.readFile(path
author: WonderLab
summary_zh: 该文是 DeepSeek Harness 系列第七篇，讲解「能力接缝（Capability Seams）」架构模式：将文件系统、Shell 执行、LLM 调用、沙箱等能力抽象为统一接口（ctx.fs / ctx.shell / ctx.llm / ctx.sandbox）。这样只需改一行配置就能把本地文件系统换成 E2B 沙箱，而工具代码完全不用改动。对构建可插拔、可测试的 AI Agent 框架有直接参考价值。

title: Can LLMs in Draft-Verify-Revise Pipelines Resolve Deictic Ambiguity?
content:
arXiv:2609.12162v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Draft-verify-revise is a common LLM orchestration pattern for scaling inference-time compute. One LLM drafts, a second critiques the draft and provides feedback, and a third uses that feedback to revise the draft into the final output. As context cascades between stages, LLMs at different stages can resolve a context-dependent expression such as "previous" differently. When that happens, the expression undergoes a deictic shift, a change in what it refers to. This phenomenon was studied with a synthetic dataset of 10 base examples, each rendered in three conditions. Holding the shared components constant, the conditions varied whether the draft stage LLM (the assistant) or the verify stage LLM (the grader) resolved the expression correctly, and how much independent reasoning the revise stage LLM (the meta-evaluator) needed to determine which reading was correct. Six models from three providers were tested across 21 reasoning effort confi
author: Obinna I. Ekekezie
summary_zh: 论文研究了「起草-验证-修订」（draft-verify-revise）这一常见 LLM 编排模式中的指示词歧义问题：当上下文在多阶段间层层传递时，不同阶段的模型可能对「previous」这类依赖上下文的表达给出不同解读，导致指代对象发生偏移。作者用 10 个基础样例 ×3 种条件的合成数据集，对比了起草阶段与验证阶段解读正确与否的组合效果。对构建多智能体审校流水线（如 Claude Code 中的 plan→review→revise 链路）有直接的可靠性警示价值。

title: T-Mem: Memory That Anticipates, Not Archives - Tencent's Breakthrough in AI Long-Term Memory
content: T-Mem: Memory That Antanticates, Not Archives The Problem with Current AI Memory Large language model agents are increasingly entering long-term companion chat scenarios — not just answering one question and leaving, but building lasting relationships with users. This creates a specific requirement for memory systems: users don't repeat the same things year after year in the same words. The memory system must retrieve past memories even when phrasing, topics, and contexts have completely changed. But today, almost all long-term memory solutions share the same fundamental assumption: as long as the query is "similar enough" to the memory, it can be retrieved. This only works when memory and dialogue have literal or semantic similarity. In real conversations, however, phrasing changes, contexts shift, yet memories still need to be recalled. Tencent's Solution: T-Mem T-Mem flips this assumption upside down: instead of struggling to find similarity at retrieval time, save preset scenarios
author: ryan2run
summary_zh: 文章介绍腾讯提出的 T-Mem 长期记忆系统，指出当前 AI 记忆方案依赖「查询与记忆语义相似」的假设，在长期陪伴式对话中因用户措辞、话题、语境不断变化而失效。T-Mem 强调「预测性记忆」而非「归档式记忆」，试图在无字面或语义相似度的情况下仍能召回过往记忆。对构建有状态 Agent、长期记忆层和 RAG 检索策略有参考价值。

title: Iris Search Agent: Open Source Context Management Beats Parameter Scaling
content: Iris Search Agent: Open Source Context Management Beats Parameter Scaling The Open Source Search Agent Revolution AllSpark Research has released Iris , an open-source search agent that is changing the competitive landscape. Two models are available: Model Total Params Active Params BrowseComp Iris-mini 35B 3B 82.2 Iris-pro 397B 17B 88.6 Both use Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 256K context windows. Weights are released under Apache 2.0. Why Search Agents Are Different Search agents differ from regular chat models because they must: Decide what to search — autonomously choose queries Evaluate results — determine if more searching is needed Know when to stop — recognize when evidence is sufficient For two years, this capability was dominated by closed-source products. Open source had little to compete with. Benchmark Results Four benchmarks, impressive results: Benchmark
author: ryan2run
summary_zh: 文章介绍了 AllSpark Research 开源的搜索智能体 Iris（Iris-mini 35B/3B 激活、Iris-pro 397B/17B 激活），采用 MoE 架构与 256K 上下文，Apache 2.0 协议发布，BrowseComp 得分分别为 82.2 和 88.6。核心观点是上下文管理能力比单纯堆参数规模更能决定搜索智能体的表现，其关键在于自主决定检索查询、评估结果充分性并判断何时停止。对关注开源 Agent 与 LLM 检索工作流的开发者有参考价值。

title: Quoting Laurie Voss
content: The cost of writing code collapsed, and the cost of reviewing, fixing and operating it is following, and I'm assuming it gets there. What's left of making software is finding out what people actually want, defining it precisely, and making it pleasant to use. That cost is per piece of software and doesn't transfer, so as the amount of software goes to infinity, which it will because there's no ceiling on demand, that cost becomes the whole job. — Laurie Voss , We are all Product Engineers now Tags: laurie-voss , generative-ai , agentic-engineering , ai , llms , deep-blue , careers
summary_zh: Laurie Voss 的观点引述：写代码的成本已经坍塌，审查、修复和运维的成本也在跟进下降，软件工程剩下的核心工作变成了搞清楚用户真正想要什么、精确定义它、并把它做得好用。这部分成本无法被 AI 转移或摊薄，随着软件数量趋于无限，它将成为工作的全部——对 AI 时代工程师的角色转型有启发。
